Composing model (Studio's composing model, composer-v1.onnx)
============================================================

Not part of this repository and not bundled in the app: the app downloads it on
demand, from this project's GitHub release "models", when someone chooses
Download on the Studio page, and checks its SHA-256 before it is used. (The app
offers it for composing, which comes in a later version.)

Source:  the Anticipatory Music Transformer, music-small-800k, by John
         Thickstun, David Hall, Chris Donahue and Percy Liang (Stanford CRFM).
         https://huggingface.co/stanford-crfm/music-small-800k
         Code: https://github.com/jthickstun/anticipation

Licence: Apache License, Version 2.0; the full text is LICENSE.txt beside this
         file (as distributed with the Anticipatory Music Transformer's code)
         and https://www.apache.org/licenses/LICENSE-2.0.

Changes: exported to ONNX with a key/value cache, its logits cut to the
         last position, and its matrix multiplications with constant weights
         and its token embedding quantised to INT8 per channel, for Steven
         Piano. The export is tools/studio/export_composer.py, documented in
         docs/STUDIO_SPIKE.md. No weights were retrained.

The model keeps its own licence; the MIT licence of this project does not apply
to it. The model was trained by its authors on the Lakh MIDI Dataset.
